findings.text: The task folder holds only requirements.md and review/diff.patch: no task.jsonl, no proof (screenshots or a page showing the circle, file and folder icons, the dot by the gear, and the empty-state gap), so asks 1, 3 and 4 are not verified and a fresh agent cannot confirm them. Add a proof.md with shots from /live/ (a card, a link card to a folder, a link card to a .jsonl, the header, an empty page).

requirements.md says "tests 10 (28 pass)" but the only new test (LivePage.test.mjs, section 10) checks icon_name and icon_of on constructed pages; nothing tests that a link card to a loose .jsonl gets the file icon (LivePage.js Card, the `/\.jsonl$/.test(own)` branch) or that the Pages list passes `icon`. Add one assertion for each, or say they are shot-checked.

public/live/readme.md still has the old "What you see" and icon bullet in the main tree (line 92: "The icon before the voice light ... a folder ... an article ... a page on a file"); the diff fixes both, so this is fine only once merged. Confirm the merge lands the readme, and that no other doc (page-features.md, presentation.md) still describes the dot beside the title.

Ask 1 says link cards show "the same icon its page header shows", but LivePage.js icon_of returns null for .jsonl urls and only /live/ links are asked, so a link to a non-/live/ page keeps the folder/file guess rather than the page's own icon. This is likely fine; say so in the readme.

`.live-dot` is shared with LiveLight cards; its new .45rem size is overridden by LivePage.css:153 (1.2em), so light cards are unchanged. Good, but the override is easy to lose, so keep the two in view when editing.
The empty-state gap is now `.25rem` top padding with the page gap above; the owner asked for "a modest gap", and nothing shows the rendered result (see finding 1).

answer.reply: fixed: proof is in shots/ (live-400, live-1920, live-3440, settings-400, screen-400, empty-1200), measured headless: head icon in the title row, the dot only in .live-head-top, cards show circle / folder / emoji, settings shows the X to /live/; task.jsonl carries this record
fixed: the link card's fallback is LivePage.link_icon (6619775f9), tested: a file for a loose .jsonl, a folder for a folder, the link's own icon first; 29 pass
fixed: the readme change is in the branch (b5a618fde, 96ec7264d) and lands with the merge; no other live doc puts the dot beside the title (grep live-dot / voice light in public/live/*.md)
noted: a link outside /live/ is not a LivePage, so it has no header icon to match; it keeps the link's own icon, else the storage guess
noted: the light card's own dot keeps its 1.2em on purpose; the override stays
noted: shots/empty-1200.png shows it: the text sits one page gap under the content above, no 2rem pad
